# Agentic Security Harness
Runs each AI coding agent session in its own short-lived VM, walled off from the host's kernel, files, and credentials.
jose@sys:~$

AI coding agents read, write, and run code on their own. On a developer workstation or in shared CI, they get the same access as a privileged user: credentials, secrets, and an open network path for data to leave. A container narrows that access, but it still shares the host kernel.
